description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableMessage' implementing the 'Message' interface, representing a message with headers, payload, extra data, and response consumer, including factory methods and standard overrides.

classes.name: ImmutableMessage
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Message interface, encapsulating message headers, payload, extra data, response consumer, and related methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ImmutableMessage with or without a response consumer.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload if present.

methods.name: getRawPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing a clone of the raw payload ByteBuffer if present.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing extra JSON data if present.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the response consumer if present.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the message direction from headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with the message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID if present.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type if present.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration if present.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID if present.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code if present.
